meta.evaluation_title: PS-03 Head-to-Head LLM Monitoring Evaluation: Go vs Python (V2)
meta.trial_design: 20 warmup excluded, 20 baseline-profile, 20 trials x 5 scenarios (200 candidate trials total)

canary_suite_12_tasks.empirical_finding: Switching from Q8_0 to Q4_K_M on the 12-task suite produces an 8.4% accuracy regression (11/12 -> 10/12) localized specifically to complex reasoning tasks, with a 20.3% latency reduction (118ms -> 94ms).
